test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select the option with the correct spelling.

Stomach sleepers were rated as being more gregairious and uncomfortable with criticism.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"gregarious"** means fond of company; sociable. (समाजप्रिय)

 
 
• **Example:** He is a** gregarious** person who enjoys being around others.
 
 
 
• **"Gregairious"** is the incorrect spelling of the word and should be corrected to **"gregarious".** (समाजप्रिय)
 
 
• **Example:** She is known for her **gregarious** nature and loves attending social events.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **gregarious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **ratedd** (रेटेड): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "rated".

 
 
• **Example:** The movie was rated highly by critics.
 
 
 
• **criticicm** (आलोचना): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "criticism".
 
 
• **Example:** She faced a lot of criticism for her controversial statements.
 
 
 
• **stomac** (पेट): This is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "stomach".
 
 
• **Example:** He had a stomach ache after eating too much.
